repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute (60,000 ms) sustained wait before the action. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period and a threshold of 60 ticks. With a 1000 ms period, 60 ticks equals only 60 seconds, not 600 seconds. Additionally, the counting logic fires one tick too early if the condition is true at t=0. The repair requires changing the wrapper period to 100 ms and setting the threshold to 601 ticks (600 intervals + 1 for the initial state).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 ms to 100 ms to match the fine-grained timing required for a 1-minute sustain window. Updated the threshold from 60 to 601 to ensure the condition is sustained for exactly 60,000 ms (600 intervals of 100 ms plus the initial check), preventing the early firing observed at 59 seconds.
